capabilities: Schedule recurring tasks with natural-language :: syntax (e.g. :: every monday ::)
Carry uncompleted tasks over to the next day's note
Snooze tasks to a later date
Count consecutive completion streaks shown in hover tooltips
Nest subtasks under parent tasks with progress percentage and X/Y counters
disambiguation: Not a standalone to-do manager; it schedules recurring tasks inside daily and periodic notes rather than tracking arbitrary project tasks.
extras: The author warns the plugin is tested only in Live Preview mode and does not work in reading view; hover tooltips only work inside the configured Daily Notes/Periodic Notes folder. Forks must credit the original author. Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: it basically replaces that uh goaltodo plugin
motivation: The author built it for their own needs and then decided to release it publicly.
problem: Obsidian's daily notes workflow has no built-in way to schedule recurring tasks, carry uncompleted tasks over to the next day, or track completion streaks.
